text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The entryway is the gateway for all kinds 
of Qi! We gotta keep it sparkling clean so 
no bad Qi sneaks into everyone's home!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Now then, next is... boost career luck, of 
course? For an Umamusume, career luck 
means nothing less than luck in races!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And so~ let's clean every last light 
fixture and give everyone's career luck a 
boost!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Worked up a good sweat. Cleaning 
high-up spots really takes a lot out of 
you, huh.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Hah—! Are you... the Dragon God...?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm flying through the sky riding the 
Dragon God...!? Amazing, amazing! To think 
I'd get a whole panoramic view of the town 
like this...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Huh? This flow of qi... Could there be a 
Dragon Hole over there too...?! There's a 
ley line there as well... I had no idea!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, incredible! To see the ki flow 
lines this clearly! With thisâ

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: —More, give me more power of the land!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh? Where am I... Oh, right. I 
finished cleaning, sat down to take a 
break, and then... was I dreaming...?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, but that dream just now was 
definitely a message from the Dragon God.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If there's a dragon vein at that spot... 
Yeah, I bet I can channel the land's 
energy into my running better than ever 
before!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, inspired by a stroke of good feng 
shui, Copano Rickey's running took on a 
sharper edge from that day forward.
